name: @rfcx/s3-storage-client
description: Thin, endpoint-aware AWS S3 client factory that routes all S3 access through the in-cluster s3-proxy (s3-reader/s3-writer chain) when AWS_S3_ENDPOINT is set. Does NOT reimplement any reader/writer logic; it only constructs the SDK client so it talks to the proxy (or default AWS when unset).
author: RFCx
